message.content:
Sure thing! To make the plan as useful as possible, could you let me know a bit more about your trip?

| What you’d like to know | Why it matters |
|--------------------------|----------------|
| **Length of stay** (e.g., 3 days, 1 week, 10 days) | Helps set a realistic daily schedule. |
| **Travel dates / season** | Weather, crowd levels, and special events vary. |
| **Budget range** (e.g., $1,000–$3,000) | Determines flight, hotel, dining, and activity choices. |
| **Interests** (art, food, history, shopping, nightlife, day‑trips, etc.) | Lets me pick the best sights and experiences for you. |
| **Accommodation preference** (hotel, Airbnb, boutique, budget hostels) | Affects location and vibe. |
| **Any special needs** (dietary restrictions, mobility concerns, etc.) | Ensures accessibility and comfort. |

Once I have those details, I’ll craft a personalized itinerary—including flights, lodging, daily activities, dining suggestions, and practical tips—so you can hit the highlights of Paris without missing anything that matters to you. If you’re happy with a general outline right now, just let me know and I’ll draft a sample plan!
